code: import axios from'axios';const backendHost=window.location.hostname==='localhost'?'localhost':window.location.hostname;const API_BASE="http://".concat(backendHost,":5000/api/user");export const getNearbyUsers=async(phone,radius)=>{try{const response=await axios.get("".concat(API_BASE,"/").concat(phone,"/nearby"),{params:{radius}});return response.data;}catch(error){console.error("Error fetching nearby users:",error);throw error;}};export const updateDiscoverySettings=async(phone,radius)=>{try{const response=await axios.put("".concat(API_BASE,"/").concat(phone,"/settings/discovery"),{max_distance:radius});return response.data;}catch(error){console.error("Error updating discovery settings:",error);throw error;}};export const likeUser=async(phone,targetPhone)=>{try{const response=await axios.post("".concat(API_BASE,"/").concat(phone,"/send-interest"),{target_phone:targetPhone});return response.data;}catch(error){console.error("Error liking user:",error);throw error;}};export const updateLocation=async(phone,latitude,longitude)=>{try{const response=await axios.post("".concat(API_BASE,"/").concat(phone,"/location"),{latitude,longitude});return response.data;}catch(error){console.error("Error updating location:",error);throw error;}};
